_overridesReasons.body-parser: BLOCKER: force 2.4.0 to clear GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828 (DoS via trailing bytes after a compressed request body; vulnerable >=2.0.0 <2.4.0) on top of GHSA-v422-hmwv-36x6 (an invalid limit value silently disabling body-size enforcement, fixed in 2.3.0). express@5 declares body-parser ^2.2.1, which 2.4.0 satisfies, and the lockfile does not move on its own. 2.4.0 (published 2026-10-22) had aged past minimum-release-age when the scheduled audit on main went red (run 40066114421).
_overridesReasons.rimraf: BLOCKER: force rimraf ^6 to avoid unmaintained v2/v3 transitive chains still referenced by older build tooling
_overridesReasons.rollup: BLOCKER: pin rollup ^4.59 to ensure all workspaces resolve the same native binary set and avoid platform-specific optional-dep drift
_overridesReasons.fast-xml-parser: BLOCKER: pin 5.12.1 (raised from 5.8.0 for @astrojs/rss 4.0.19, then from 5.10.1 for deps freshness, then from 5.11.0, 5.11.1, 5.11.2 and 5.12.0 for the same reason; now 5.12.1) to carry the CDATA/comment injection fix (GHSA-gh4j-gqv2-49f6) plus the entity-expansion limit family; without the pin transitive consumers drift below the fixed range
_overridesReasons.flatted: BLOCKER: force >=3.4.2 to pick up prototype pollution fix landed after vitest/@vitest transitive pin held older versions
_overridesReasons.smol-toml: BLOCKER: force >=1.6.1 to pick up DoS-via-commented-lines fix; astro toolchain otherwise pulls older transitive versions
_overridesReasons.h3: BLOCKER: bound >=1.15.11 <2 (unstorage 1.17.6 declares ^1.15.11) to include SSE carriage-return sanitization + path traversal fixes while the tree shares the one h3 major unstorage requires; an open >=1.15.9 resolved h3 2.0.8 outside that range
_overridesReasons.hono: BLOCKER: force >=4.12.25 to carry the >=4.12.18 fixes plus serve-static path traversal (GHSA-wwfh-h76j-fc44), CORS wildcard reflection (GHSA-88fw-hqm2-52qc), Set-Cookie merge (GHSA-j6c9-x7qj-28xf), body-limit bypass (GHSA-rv63-4mwf-qqc2), and Lambda@Edge header drop (GHSA-wgpf-jwqj-8h8p); @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (now only via @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk in packages/www) transitively pulls older hono; packages/cli uses hono and @hono/node-server directly
_overridesReasons.@hono/node-server: BLOCKER: force >=1.19.13 to pair with hono >=4.12.25 override; pre-1.19 cannot start against hono 4.12.x
_overridesReasons.vite: BLOCKER: bound >=8.3.6 <9 (astro 7.4.11 declares ^8.3.6) so the whole tree shares the one vite major astro 7 requires (astro ^8.0.13, @astrojs/react ^8.3.0) and carries the dev-server path-traversal + fs.deny fixes; vitest 5 declares vite ^6.4.0 || ^7.0.0 || ^8.0.0, so the cli/shared/provisioning/e2e-tests vitest suites run on the same copy. Bounded <9 so an untested vite major is never adopted implicitly
_overridesReasons.postcss: BLOCKER: force >=8.5.32 (vite 8.3.8 declares ^8.5.32) to include GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93 XSS-via-unescaped-style-tag and GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 sourceMappingURL path-traversal (arbitrary .map file disclosure, patched 8.5.18) fixes; vite/marpit transitives otherwise hold tree at 8.5.8
_overridesReasons.fast-uri: BLOCKER: force >=3.1.9 to include GHSA-w74x-v6f9-j3xg (scheme spoofing via percent-encoded scheme decoding), GHSA-xhq7-xmqj-769h (relative-reference dot-segment normalization), GHSA-wjr9-j795-jxcr (host confusion via unchecked WHATWG host canonicalization) and GHSA-333x-w4r6-6crp (scheme injection via a first-segment colon), all fixed in 3.1.9. It also carries the 3.1.3 fixes GHSA-q3j6-qgpj-74h6, GHSA-v39h-62p7-jpjc and GHSA-4c8g-83qw-93j6; ajv@8.20.0 otherwise holds the older 3.1.8. Bounded <4 because the only consumer in this tree is ajv@8.20.0, which declares fast-uri ^3.0.1; an unbounded range would drag the untested 4.x major into the MCP SDK's schema validator.
_overridesReasons.fast-xml-builder: BLOCKER: force >=1.3.2, the range fast-xml-parser 5.12.1 declares, which also carries the GHSA-5wm8-gmm8-39j9 attribute-quote injection fix; aws-sdk @aws-sdk/xml-builder transitively pulls older fast-xml-parser/fast-xml-builder
_overridesReasons.ip-address: BLOCKER: force ^10.5.1 to include GHSA-v2v4-37r5-5v8g (XSS in Address6 HTML-emitting methods, affected <= 10.1.0), GHSA-rpw4-54j3-4h4q (Address6.isLinkLocal matches fe80::/64 instead of fe80::/10) and GHSA-2vr4-cq9g-pvrc (no classifier recognizes the NAT64 local-use range 64:ff9b:1::/48), the last two affected <= 10.5.0 and patched in 10.5.1; express-rate-limit (production) declares ip-address ^10.2.0 and froze the lockfile at 10.4.0, so the caret alone never moves it
_overridesReasons.protobufjs: BLOCKER: force >=7.5.6 to clear the 7.x advisories (GHSA-66ff/2pr8/fx83/75px/jvwf/685m/q6x5/xq3m all affected <= 7.5.5) — npm picks 8.2.0+ for the otlp-transformer chain which also clears the 8.0.0-8.0.1 critical RCE; @opentelemetry/sdk-node is pinned in .syncpackrc.json so we cannot bump the outer tree
_overridesReasons.@grpc/proto-loader: BLOCKER: nested override pins protobufjs ^7.5.6 inside the @grpc/proto-loader chain since proto-loader@0.8.x requires the 7.x major and cannot accept 8.x; pairs with the outer protobufjs >=7.5.6 override which handles the 8.x consumers
_overridesReasons.zod: BLOCKER: force ^4.6.5 across the whole tree so @modelcontextprotocol/server (zod ^4.2.0), the v1 @modelcontextprotocol/sdk that @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk still pulls, and the cli workspace share the same physical zod copy, at the same version private/account pins exactly (4.6.7), because @rediacc/shared crosses that repo boundary and 4.6 added validate/validateAsync to ZodType, so a 4.5.x schema no longer satisfies a 4.6.x ZodTypeAny; without the override the SDK satisfies its 'zod: ^3.25 || ^4.0' range with the older zod@3.25.x that other transitives drag in, creating two zod installs whose v4/core $ZodType interfaces TS treats as distinct nominal types (build breaks at registerTool inputSchema)
_overridesReasons.js-yaml: BLOCKER: force >=4.3.2 <5.0.0 to include the GHSA-h67p-54hq-rp68 (quadratic-complexity DoS via repeated merge-key aliases) and GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh (maxTotalMergeKeys does not count empty mappings, so a large sequence of them burns CPU without ever reaching the configured limit, vulnerable >=4.0.0 <4.3.2) fixes while staying off the v5 major; the second of those was published 2026-09-19 and is what moved this bound from >=4.3.1 to >=4.3.2 on 2026-09-23. @astrojs/markdown-remark and astro transitively pull an unpatched js-yaml, and @astrojs/markdown-remark's `import yaml from "js-yaml"` default import breaks under js-yaml 5.x's ESM-only export shape (observed as a hard `astro build` SyntaxError)
_overridesReasons.gray-matter: BLOCKER: nested override pins js-yaml ^3.15.2 inside the gray-matter chain since gray-matter's frontmatter parser is written against the js-yaml v3 API and cannot accept v4; both GHSA-h67p-54hq-rp68 and GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh cover two disjoint ranges apiece, and the second one's v3 arm is >=3.0.0 <3.15.2, so the v3 line needs 3.15.2 rather than the 3.15.0 that cleared the first
_overridesReasons.linkify-it: BLOCKER: force >=5.0.1 to include GHSA-22p9-wv53-3rq4 (quadratic-complexity DoS in LinkifyIt#match) fix; markdown-it (via @marp-team/marpit) transitively pulls linkify-it@5.0.0
_overridesReasons.brace-expansion@^5.0.5: BLOCKER: clear GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp and GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (unbounded expansion LENGTH — expand() caps the result count but not each result's size, so chained brace groups OOM the process; vulnerable <=5.0.7, patched 5.0.8) plus GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 (the 5.0.8 maxLength mitigation was incomplete, intermediate arrays stayed unbounded; completed in 5.0.9), raised to 5.0.12 for GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr (quadratic `{a},b}` rewrite, patched 5.0.10), GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7 (recursion on nested groups, patched 5.0.11) and GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p (recursion in parseCommaParts, patched 5.0.12), all scoped >=4.0.0 so the ^1.1.7 pin is unaffected, for the single top-level minimatch@10 edge that requests ^5.0.5. This consumer expects the v5 named-export API, so it stays on the v5 line — kept separate from the ^1.1.7 override above so neither consumer is forced across brace-expansion's v4->v5 export-shape break.
_overridesReasons.qs: BLOCKER: force >=6.16.1. 6.16.0 cleared GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx (arrayLimit/throwOnLimitExceeded bypass via bracket-key comma parsing, affected >=6.14.2 <=6.15.3) and GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g (stringify DoS via a non-callable constructor.isBuffer, affected >=2.2.5 <6.16.0); both reach PRODUCTION deps, where the audit gate has zero tolerance, through express (qs ^6.14.0) and body-parser. The floor is 6.16.1 because body-parser 2.4.0 declares qs ^6.16.1, and an override floor below a dependent's own range leaves npm resolving a version that dependent never accepted. Bounded <7 because no 7.x exists and an unbounded range would adopt an untested major into express's query parser.
